messages:
Maya (CS): FYI — Kestrel renewal for Q3 just went into procurement. They asked whether we can accept CC for the initial deposit vs wire. Also new complication: their EU affiliate needs to sign, not the US parent. Need sign-off on payment path + who signs the SOW.

Oliver (AE): Thanks Maya. Do we already have the affiliate onboarding record? I thought they provisioned the US entity only. If affiliate signs, pricing needs to be on the EU legal entity (VAT implications).

Emma (Kestrel): Confirmed — their procurement told us affiliate "Kestrel EU GmbH" must be the contracting party. They can do CC but prefer invoice on their EU ledger.

Maya (CS): Ok — two action items: 1) Legal confirms whether we can route SOW to affiliate without changing commercial terms, 2) Finance confirms CC vs wire for initial deposit and invoicing to EU entity (VAT).

Priya (Legal): We can do affiliate contracting but need a quick amendment: change contracting party name and billing entity. No material change to T&Cs. I'll draft a 1-paragraph addendum and route for signature. Note: if they pay by CC, our standard merchant flow will apply. If they want invoice for bookkeeping, Finance needs the org ID + VAT number.

Jorge (Finance): I need the affiliate's billing entity name, VAT ID, and whether they want card on file or one-off card. For card: ask them to confirm billing address matches VAT registration to avoid chargeback flags. If they prefer wire, we can attach EU bank details, but processing takes 3 business days.

Oliver (AE): Emma — can you push those details (VAT ID + billing address)? Also, they asked about adding seats mid-term — we should lock pricing for the renewal term.

Emma (Kestrel): Sharing VAT and billing address now: VAT DE123456789, Billing: Kestrel EU GmbH, Sonnenstrasse 12, 80331 Munich. They want one-off CC for deposit, then net30 invoices for monthly usage. Seats: +10 seats at $50/mo, confirmed.

Maya (CS): Great. Priya — once you have the addendum, can we do e-sign via DocuSign for the affiliate? Prefer minimal friction.

Priya (Legal): Yes. I'll prepare the addendum with affiliate name + PO reference and send via DocuSign. Two signer flow: Kestrel EU (primary) then Redwood (standard). Any customer-signed PO goes as an attachment.

DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x8f3d created by Priya. Status: sent to Kestrel EU GmbH (signer 1). Link: https://docusign.example/envelopes/0x8f3d

Oliver (AE): One more thing — pricing currency. Their CFO wants invoices in EUR. We bill USD by default. Finance, can we emit EUR invoices for this account?

Jorge (Finance): We can issue EUR invoices if they set EU billing entity and provide IBAN for wire or CC billing in EUR. For card charges we can collect in EUR if the merchant supports multicurrency. I'll confirm with payments ops.

Maya (CS): Noted. Also want to capture a small enablement ask: they requested a 30-min walk-through of reporting for their EU ops team after renewal signs. Can we schedule that post-signature?

Oliver (AE): I'll own scheduling. Proposed slots next Tue/Wed mornings CET.

Emma (Kestrel): Tue 10:00 CET works. We'll confirm after DocuSign completes.

Priya (Legal): DocuSign shows signer viewed envelope. If we get signature today, we can invoice the deposit and set up billing.

DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0x8f3d signed by Kestrel EU GmbH at 1749998975. Status: completed.

Jorge (Finance): Received signed addendum. I'll generate a EUR invoice for the deposit and email payment link for one-off CC. Sending now to accounting@kestrel.eu.

Maya (CS): Perfect. Please attach the invoice #INV-2026-328 in the contract folder. Oliver — can you loop Emma once invoice is sent so they can process CC?

Oliver (AE): Invoice sent. Emma, check spam if you don't see it. Payment link included.

Emma (Kestrel): Got it — payment processed via CC. Transaction ID: tx_0a9c. Will post confirmation once it lands in our ledger.

Maya (CS): Closing loop — renewal executed with affiliate contracting, EUR invoicing for deposit via CC, seats added. Next steps: schedule reporting enablement (Oliver), update account record with EU billing entity (Maya), and mark renewal closed in CRM (Oliver). :tada:

Oliver (AE): Marking CRM renewal as closed-won. Thanks team.

Jorge (Finance): I'll reconcile once payment settles. If any VAT doc needed, ping me.

Priya (Legal): Saved signed addendum to GDrive: https://drive.example/redwood/kestrel/addendum_signed.pdf

Maya (CS): Thanks everyone — tagging @Emma once more for confirmation of ledger posting.

Emma (Kestrel): Payment posted. All good from our side. Thanks for the smooth flow! :thumbsup:
